text.en:
1. (1) Kaedah-kaedah ini bolehlah dinamakan Kaedah-Kaedah Motosikal

(Topi Keledar) (Pindaan) 2012.

(2) Kaedah-Kaedah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 September 2012.

Pindaan kaedah 3

2. Kaedah-Kaedah Motosikal (Topi Keledar) 1973 [P.U. (A) 43/1973] dipinda

dengan menggantikan subkaedah 3(1) dengan subkaedah yang berikut:

"(1) Tiap-tiap topi keledar hendaklah menepati spesifikasi MS 1 Specification

for Protective Helmets for Vehicle Users atau United Nations Economic

Commission for Europe Regulation No. 22 Uniform Provisions Concerning the

Approval of Protective Helmets and their Visors for Driver and Passengers of

Motorcycles and Mopeds.".

Dibuat 4 April 2012

[KP/PUU/0.440/W/BD/9; PN(PU2)460/LXVI]

DATO' SERI KONG CHO HA

Menteri Pengangkutan

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

MOTORCYCLES (SAFETY HELMETS) (AMENDMENT) RULES 2012

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 88(1)(s) of the Road Transport Act

1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following rules:
